diagnostics.message: module.runner:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.gitlab_runner_instance launches the runner agent instance whose user-data script writes the runner token into the SSM parameter module.runner:resource.aws_ssm_parameter.runner_registration_token (referenced only by name via local.secure_parameter_store_runner_token_key, no attribute reference). The parameter must exist before the instance boots, otherwise the user-data script cannot store the runner token and Terraform's ownership of the parameter is broken.

module.runner:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.gitlab_runner_instance launches the runner agent instance whose user-data logging configuration (data.template_file.logging) targets the CloudWatch log group module.runner:resource.aws_cloudwatch_log_group.environment by name only. The log group must exist before the instance boots, otherwise the logging agent creates it out-of-band and Terraform then fails to create the same group.
